# Warlock Access

> Package: `@warlock.js/access`

> Authorization (RBAC + ABAC) for Warlock.js applications

## Skills

- [check-permissions](@warlock.js/access/check-permissions/SKILL.md): Check permissions in @warlock.js/access; use when you need to check permissions.
- [configure-access](@warlock.js/access/configure-access/SKILL.md): Configure access in @warlock.js/access; use when you need to configure access.
- [define-policies](@warlock.js/access/define-policies/SKILL.md): Define policies (ABAC) in @warlock.js/access; use when you need to define policies.
- [implement-resolver](@warlock.js/access/implement-resolver/SKILL.md): Implement a resolver in @warlock.js/access; use when you need to implement resolver.
- [manage-roles](@warlock.js/access/manage-roles/SKILL.md): Manage roles in @warlock.js/access; use when you need to manage roles.
- [overview](@warlock.js/access/overview/SKILL.md): @warlock.js/access overview for orientation and choosing the focused skill for the task.
